en-US: Render Dataview inline fields such as [due:: YYYY-MM-DD] as compact editor chips, and keep the raw field editable on click.
Highlight Markdown source and switch editor themes from the toolbar.
Remember the last AI assistant action and open the assistant from the current selection or the whole note.
zh-CN: 把 [due:: YYYY-MM-DD] 这类 Dataview 字段在编辑器里收成安静的小标签，点击后仍可编辑原文。
Markdown 源码高亮，并支持从工具栏切换编辑器主题。
记住上次的 AI 助手操作，并支持从当前选区或整篇笔记打开助手。
